description: Check the calling account's API usage and remaining quota for this month (tier, used, remaining, limit, reset date). Use BEFORE running many calls to avoid hitting rate limits.
name: get_usage

outputSchema.description: API request usage and plan limit for the organization behind the API key.

limit.description: Monthly request allowance for the org's tier.

remaining.description: Requests left this month. Null on an unlimited plan.

requests_this_month.description: Requests since the start of the current month — the number metered against the limit.

total_requests.description: All-time request count across the org's keys.
